newsitem.title: TURKEY: Six Turkish brokerages have licenses revoked.
newsitem.headline: Six Turkish brokerages have licenses revoked.

text.p: Turkey's regulatory Capital Markets Board (SPK) cancelled all capital market trading licences of six Turkish brokerage houses due to weak finances and decided to file bankruptcy suits against them, it announced in its weekly bulletin.

The SPK said the capital market activities of the brokerage houses -- Birikim, Salahsun Hekimoglu, Onder, Turmen, Bogazici and Yener Kaya -- had already been suspended for an indefinite period earlier in the year.
There are currently 101 brokerage houses licensed to operate on the Istanbul Stock Exchange.
